metadata.title: Vertiv stock surges as orders double amid AI build-out: 'Evolving faster than ever'

content.text:
Vertiv (VRT) stock surged 13% as the data center infrastructure player showed it continues to benefit from the massive spending from the likes of Google (GOOG) and Microsoft (MSFT).
"We are in the middle of the largest infrastructure buildout and it's accelerating," Vertiv's CEO Giordano Albertazzi stated in the company's earnings release. "The demands on data center infrastructure are evolving faster than ever, and Vertiv's role in that buildout keeps expanding."
Vertiv makes power and cooling hardware for data centers and enterprise networks. The company explained that as AI fuels demand for this infrastructure, its orders have doubled year over year. The company counts Alphabet, Microsoft, Nvidia (NVDA), and Amazon (AMZN) among its customers, per S&P Global Market Intelligence.
That demand, plus strong third quarter results, have given Vertiv the confidence to raise its full-year outlook. In 2026, the company expects net sales of $14.45 billion to $14.85 billion, up from $13.8 billion to $14.2 billion.
Adjusted diluted earnings per share are expected to be $7.10-$7.20 for the year, representing earnings growth of 69%-71%. The midpoint of that range is above the $6.73 per share forecast Wall Street analysts penciled in.
In the third quarter, Vertiv reported net sales of $4.31 billion, beating Wall Street's expectations of $3.76 billion. Adjusted diluted earnings per share of $2.21 grew 78% year over year, also beating estimates of $1.82 per share.
